steps.title: Account Sync
steps.content: Click the Account Sync button in the upper-right corner of the app.

steps.title: Choose a provider
steps.content: Click Connect next to Google Drive or Microsoft OneDrive.

steps.title: Sync my files
steps.content: Check Sync my files so Marginalia can index your notes by scripture reference.

steps.title: Connect
steps.content: Click Connect, then follow the prompts to grant Marginalia access to your files.
